name: Evil For Good
overview: The Scriptures reveal the painful reality of receiving evil in return for good, as seen in Joseph's rebuke of his brothers for their betrayal despite his kindness (Genesis 44:4). Similarly, the Israelites repeatedly respond to God's deliverance through Moses with complaints and distrust, questioning why they were brought out of Egypt only to face hardship in the wilderness (Exodus 5:21; 14:11; 15:24; 16:2-3). These passages underscore the human tendency to murmur and resist God's providential guidance even when He acts for their benefit.
